messages.subject: ColorQuantile - Side effects
parts:
Hi everyone, I'm currently working on an application which works both with Shiny and leaflet,

The thing is I'm using the function called colorQuantile() from the leaflet library to display a raster over a map that should display a threshold given an argument (the % of the threshold the user wants), and if the user decide to choose 0% there is an error which is triggered : Breaks are not unique.

I've been thinking about a solution, but the only thing I've come up with, is to catch inside the function if two breaks are the same in order to avoid one of them (but it's not the right thing to do...)
